To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
shear strength profiles of slope sediments can be used to identify and characterize the different mass movements that occur on the continental slope.

(1) shear strength profiles of slope mass transport deposits can be used to identify sediment evacuation and deposition processes; (2) the shear strength of the mass transport deposits is controlled by the degree of deformation and the amount of fluid loss during emplacement; and (3) the shear strength profiles can be used to infer the thickness of the mass transport deposit, and the amount of sediment evacuation.
shear strength profiles, from the continental slope of Campos Basin, can be used to distinguish between different sediment transport processes.

the use of downhole shear strength data to characterise the geotechnical response and to infer the sedimentological history of mass transport deposits.
the geotechnical properties of mass movement deposits in the continental slope.

the shear strength profiles of mass movement deposits, as measured from the cone penetrometer, are controlled by sedimentary processes, rather than by the type of mass movement.
the shear strength profiles are not a good predictor of the type of sediment transport mechanism.
shear strength signatures of the mass movements in the Campos Basin are related to the degree of internal deformation and fluid expulsion.

shear strength signatures of mass movements can be identified and used for the detection of sedimentary structures in the subsurface.
the shear strength profiles of mass movement deposits can be used to distinguish between different mass movement types.
the shear strength of a mass transport deposit is controlled by the type of mass movement that generated it.
The main takeaway from our work is that
mass movement deposits are not necessarily associated with low shear strength, and that a high shear strength signature may be used to recognise the presence of folded deposits.
